lighting.reflections: material BRDF; no planar or ray-traced reflection pass

navigation.support: Layer-aware five-sample footprint support using downward exact-triangle rays
navigation.blocking: multiheight, body-width swept rays with axis sliding
navigation.bounds: Source-authored XZ bounds clamp the body radius before the world edge

validation.sourceHashes: recorded by scripts/validate.mjs after final source export

simulation.locomotion: Exact authored 3D polylines, constant speed across sampled waypoints, independent source animation phases
simulation.interaction: Walking actors wait on their lane within 0.9m of the player and 0.64m of another actor, crossfading authored Walk and Idle clips; no solid crowd walls
simulation.sourceTiming: Player and pedestrian waits affect runtime timing only; route geometry and complete source GLB meshes remain unchanged
simulation.materialVariation: Authored palette tint on RomanTunic material only, shared by asset and color
